page_title: LUT 2-3 AST | Luton v Aston Villa 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Teden Mengi (Luton) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
90+5' Alfie Doughty (Luton) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+5' Ross Barkley (Luton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Luton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+2' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 2 - 3 Goal! Moussa Diaby picks out Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom left corner with a header from close range. 2:3.
87' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Emiliano Martinez has no trouble gathering it.
87' Alfie Doughty (Luton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Luton.
85' Carlton Morris (Luton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
84' Rob Edwards is forced to make a change. Tahith Chong is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
82' Tahith Chong (Luton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
81' Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to intercept the corner from Alfie Doughty (Luton).

81' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Luton. Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
79' Substitution. Youri Tielemans is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Morgan Rogers trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa).
79' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) replaces Leon Bailey.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) coming on for Alex Moreno.

75' Carlton Morris (Luton) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Emiliano Martinez, who pulls off a comfortable save!
72' 2 - 2 Alfie Doughty floats a lovely ball in from the free kick to Carlton Morris (Luton), and he slots the ball into the bottom left corner to increase the score to 2:2.
70' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
66' 1 - 2 Goal! Tahith Chong (Luton) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
66' Reece Burke (Luton) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
66' Alfie Doughty (Luton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
66' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Luton win a corner.
65' 6:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.
62' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in a cross from the corner, but Emiliano Martinez reads it well and gathers the ball.
61' The ball is cleared after Issa Kabore (Luton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Luton.
57' Carlton Morris (Luton) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just over the bar from close in.
54' Emiliano Martinez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alfie Doughty (Luton).

54' Issa Kabore (Luton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' It's time for a substitution. Daiki Hashioka (Luton) comes on in place of Andros Townsend.
52' Carlton Morris (Luton) is adjudged offside.
51' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
51' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tahith Chong (Luton). The referee blows his whistle, Luton are awarded a corner kick.
50' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
49' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Thomas Kaminski easily deals with the threat.
48' The Aston Villa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+9' The end of the first half.
45+7' It's a nice effort by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Thomas Kaminski. Easy save.
45+5' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Luton comes to nothing.
45+1' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Tahith Chong (Luton) inside the box. Corner kick. Luton will have an opportunity.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
45' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

44' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Aston Villa players have a reason to celebrate!
39' Attention! Referee Michael Oliver straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
38' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Reece Burke (Luton) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.
34' Teden Mengi (Luton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
33' Teden Mengi (Luton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

32' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
32' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) works the corner short.
31' The resulting corner from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is cleared by the opposition's defence. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
30' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Aston Villa as they win a corner.
29' Unai Emery is forced to make a change. Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is unable to continue due to injury, Morgan Rogers comes on.
27' Luton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
24' 0 - 1 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
23' The referee awards a corner and Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) goes over to take it.

23' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Thomas Kaminski is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
22' The foul by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
20' The percentage of ball possession is – 38:62.
17' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
16' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
16' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) will take the corner.
15' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

14' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Thomas Kaminski, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.
11' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
7' Flag up against Andros Townsend (Luton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
6' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
5' Amari'i Bell is being substituted because of an injury. Rob Edwards sends Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) on the pitch.
4' Looks like Amari'i Bell (Luton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
4' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
2' A clever short pass gives Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Luton will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Oliver.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
